When my [Omnimon] would leave the battle area, but it's prevented from leaving by BT20-100 [The Last Guardian]'s
effect, can I then use this card's [All Turns] effect to gain 2 memory?

Effect: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)

[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 5000 DP or lower Digimon card from your hand without paying the cost. Then, all of your level 3 or higher Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞ until your opponent's turn ends.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your other Digimon would leave the battle area, gain 2 memory.
